title: Weak convergence of derivatives of uniformly Lipschitz, uniformly convergent functions against C¹ compactly supported test fields
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ and K ≥ 0. Let u_k : ℝ^d → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) be K-Lipschitz functions converging uniformly on ℝ^d to u : ℝ^d → ℝ, and let Ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^d be C¹ with compact support. Write Dv(y) for the Fréchet derivative (fderiv) of v at y, which is 0 where v is not differentiable, and use Lebesgue measure on ℝ^d (volume on Euclid d) and Bochner integrals. Then ∫ Du_k(y)[Ψ(y)] dy → ∫ Du(y)[Ψ(y)] dy as k → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (K : NNReal) (us : ℕ → Euclid d → ℝ) (u : Euclid d → ℝ) (Ψ : Euclid d → Euclid d), (∀ k, LipschitzWith K (us k)) → TendstoUniformly us u atTop → ContDiff ℝ 1 Ψ → HasCompactSupport Ψ → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y, fderiv ℝ (us k) y (Ψ y)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y, fderiv ℝ u y (Ψ y)))
